SELECT video_id, task_id, platform, account_id, post_id, origin_url, local_path, storage_status, analyze_status, duration_sec, width, height, frame_extracted_cnt, frame_analyzed_cnt, frame_stored_cnt, video_analysis_text, video_analysis_json, error_message, created_at, analyzed_at FROM collect_videos WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, video_id ASC
